purpose: A clean move on a topic branch, arriving through a merge commit.

windows.head: m1
windows.note: the merge against its first parent; a walk that skips merges never forms this window

notes: One pair, two windows, and the choice between them is `e1.2`'s merge policy rather than any matcher's business. Under `MergePolicy::Skip` the merge contributes no file rows and a reviewer reading main sees no move at all.
